Fry the beef strips in the oil until crisp and remove, then brown the chicken in batches.

Add the grape juice, balsamic, stock and herbs, return the chicken, cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Brown the mushrooms and pearl onions in 20 g butter and add with the crisp strips for 15 minutes; reduce the sauce until glossy.
Toss the cooked noodles with the remaining butter and serve with the chicken.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes, and boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
Whisk 3 tbsp oil with vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper.
Season the tuna, brush with the remaining oil and sear for 1 to 2 minutes per side, then slice.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, olives, halved eggs and anchovies.
Top with tuna and drizzle with the dressing.
Mix the butter with garlic, parsley, lemon and salt, roll in paper and chill.
Fry the potatoes at 160°C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 190°C for 3 minutes until crisp.
Season the steaks and sear in the olive oil for 3 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Serve with a slice of garlic butter on top and the fries.

Add the onion, herbs, peppercorns and salt and simmer gently for 2.5 hours.
Add the carrots, leeks, turnips and celery and cook for 30 minutes, then the potatoes for 20 minutes.
Serve the broth first, then the beef and vegetables with mustard and coarse salt.

Soften the onion and garlic, add the tomato paste, tomatoes, stock and lemon juice.

Melt the butter, soften the shallots, add the stock and balsamic and reduce by half.
Stir in the cream and mustard and simmer until thick.
Fry the potatoes twice until crisp and serve with the steaks and sauce.
Whisk the flour, one egg, salt and water to a thin batter and rest 1 hour.
Melt a little butter in a large pan and spread a ladle of batter thinly.

Fold the edges over into a square, leaving the yolk showing, and cook until the white sets.

Add the stock and lemon juice, return the chicken, cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the crème fraîche and tarragon and simmer 5 minutes.

Top with the rest of the béchamel and cheese and bake at 220°C for 10 minutes, then grill until bubbling.
Fry the eggs sunny side up.
Place an egg on each sandwich and serve.
Cut a pocket in each chicken breast and fill with a slice of turkey and cheese.
Coat in seasoned flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side, then bake at 190°C for 15 minutes.
Boil the beans for 5 minutes and toss with butter and salt.
Serve the cordon bleu with the beans.
Soak the chicken in buttermilk with salt for 30 minutes.
Dredge in flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt and fry at 175°C for 5 minutes until golden.
Fry the potatoes twice until crisp and salt.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, the vinegar and salt for coleslaw.
Mix the honey, mustard and remaining mayonnaise for the dip and serve everything together.

Boil and mash the potatoes with 40 g butter, 150 ml milk and salt.

Shape the beef into two patties slightly wider than the buns and season well.
Fry the potatoes twice until crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise, ketchup and relish for the special sauce.
Grill or sear the patties for 3 minutes per side, adding the cheese for the last minute, and toast the buns.
Build the burgers with sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and the patty and serve with fries.

Sear the steak in the remaining oil over high heat for 2 minutes, season and chop with spatulas.
Mix in the vegetables and divide into two piles.
Lay the cheese on top and let it melt.
Scoop each pile into a toasted roll.
Fry the turkey rashers until crisp.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer bread, turkey breast and lettuce, then bread, rashers and tomato, then the last bread.
Fry the turkey rashers until crisp.
Layer lettuce, tomato, avocado and turkey and season with pepper.
Close the sandwiches and cut in half.
Mix the mayonnaise, ketchup and relish for the dressing.
Spread the dressing on two slices of rye.
Layer the corned beef, sauerkraut and cheese and top with the remaining bread.
Fry in a pan for 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts.
Soften the onion and celery in the butter for 6 minutes and stir in the flour.

Add the milk, cream and clams and heat gently without boiling.
Hollow out the rolls and ladle the chowder inside.
Boil the macaroni until just al dente and drain.

Mix in the pasta and turkey and pour into a dish.
Top with the remaining cheese, breadcrumbs and butter and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Season the beef and brown well on all sides in the oil.

Brown the beef with the onion, pepper and garlic, add the spices and tomato paste.

Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, then stir in the egg, milk and butter.

Fry the tortilla strips in the remaining oil until crisp.

Toss the greens, beans, corn and tomatoes.
Top with chicken and tortilla strips and drizzle with the dressing.
Season the steaks and grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side, then rest and slice.
Whisk 3 tbsp oil with balsamic, mustard, salt and pepper.
Toss the greens, tomatoes, onion and cucumber with the dressing.

Shred the beef and toss with the sauce; mix the cabbage, carrot and mayonnaise with salt.
Pile the beef and slaw into the buns.
Fry the turkey rashers until crisp.
Make a mornay sauce: melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk, then the cheddar, nutmeg and salt.
Toast the bread and place in two ovenproof dishes.
Layer the turkey and tomato on the toast and pour over the sauce, then sprinkle with parmesan.
Grill until bubbling and top with the crisp rashers.
Mix the sweet potato, beans, quinoa, breadcrumbs, spices and salt and shape into three patties.

Fry in the oil for 4 minutes per side until crusted.

Shape the mince into two small patties and sear for 2 minutes per side, adding cheese at the end.

Build two of each slider: cheeseburger with tomato, beef with coleslaw and chicken with mayonnaise.

Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the chicken in it.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, dill, garlic powder and salt for ranch.
Fill with lettuce, tomato, buffalo chicken and ranch and roll up.
Season and grill the chicken for 6 minutes per side and dice.
Fry the turkey rashers until crisp and chop, and boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Arrange the lettuce and lay the chicken, rashers, chopped egg, avocado, tomatoes and cheese in rows.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Soak the breadcrumbs in 100 ml milk, then mix with the beef, onion, egg, worcestershire, thyme and salt.
Shape into a loaf in a tin.
Mix the ketchup, sugar and vinegar and spread over the top.
Bake at 180°C for 60 minutes and rest 10 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter, the rest of the milk and salt and serve with slices of meatloaf.

Soak the bread in the tomato for 10 minutes.
Blend with the garlic, vinegar and salt, then drizzle in the oil until thick and creamy.
Serve topped with chopped egg, turkey and a drizzle of oil.

Dress with the remaining oil, vinegar, garlic and salt.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.
Brown the chicken in the oil and remove.
Soften the onion, peppers and garlic for 10 minutes.

Finish with parsley and serve with bread or rice.
